title: Chapter 320: Special Status Of A Great Clan
content:
Chapter 320: Special Status Of A Great Clan

In Wu Qing's opinion, the real strength of the strange-looking powerful man from the Tianwai Human Race camp just reached the ten-star standard, and he was considered the weakest among the powerful beings.

In the system-affiliated world, it is almost difficult to see a king in this state, because he is too weak and has no development prospects, so there is no need for a breakthrough.

But in this world, as long as the strength breaks through to a high level, it can display extremely strong combat power.

There is no need to worry about whether there is a future for development in this world. The suppression of strength in this world is too strong. It is a blessing to be able to break through.

The attacks launched by such a weak power in this world are much more powerful than the most powerful peak king in the world affiliated with the system. This is the difference between the worlds.

That day, the powerful man from the human camp seemed to be unable to believe that his full-strength attack could not break through a layer of protective shield, so he returned his palm and swatted it away.

The area outside the main city of the Tianwai human race was turned upside down. The Zerg puppies and Type 3 Zerg poisonous ray scorpions that had burrowed into the ground were all pulled out. They received fatal blows and disappeared one after another.

The great power of the human camp outside the sky was sure that there was no problem with his attack. It must be the great power of the Zerg tribe that had taken action in secret, so he slapped the giant mental power shield guarding the main battle force of the Zerg tribe with one palm after another.

As long as the Zerg can take action, his goal this time will be achieved.

Every palm of the mighty power of the human camp outside the world makes the invisible mental power shield almost material. The attacks from palm to palm also allow the insect queen to become familiar with her own power in actual combat and experiment with the means of controlling power. , testing the tolerance limits of the world's rules.

The power of the Insect Queen will continue to grow due to the development of the Zerg. The recent development of the Zerg is too fast. With the powerful ability of the Insect Queen, it is difficult for the Insect Queen to accurately control the situation in this confusing world in such a short period of time. Control your own surge in power.

The aftermath of the battle between the Zerg and the outer human camp, the Great Nong, wiped out all life around the main battle force of the Zerg. The power of the power of heaven and earth mobilized by the Almighty using the rules of the world was not something that ordinary life could withstand.

The human army outside the sky and the Zerg army outside the mental power shield continued to retreat far away, away from the area where the powerful forces could fight.

"Rumble...!"

Thunder exploded in the clear sky, the sky gradually darkened, and the unscrupulous attacks from the human camp outside the sky caused changes in the celestial phenomena.

"Boom...!"

The thunder continued and the world seemed to be angry.

That day, the powerful people in the human camp ignored this and continued to attack. Every blow had the power to destroy an army.

The mental power shield controlled by the Insect Queen has become more and more stable after constant adjustments in actual combat. Supported by the Insect Queen's almost infinite mental power, it can still deal with large-scale attacks even without using the full version of the almighty power. A powerful attack.

"What is going on? Are the Zerg using battlefield treasures? Or are there powerful people taking action?"

"There should be a powerful Zerg taking action, but this power doesn't seem to be up to the standard of a powerful power, but it is much stronger than ordinary power. It is a very strange state!"

"Is it because the power of the Zerg Race is too weak?"

"No matter how weak the powerful powerful is, it is always possible to counterattack. In this state, it seems that the powerful powerful people of the Zerg race are deliberately controlling their own power, avoiding the restrictions of the world's rules, and tempting the powerful powers of the human camp outside the world to continuously attack!"

"This powerful person from the human camp outside the world is completely useless, and he still needs to catch up with the race behind him!"

"The world is angry. If he continues to fight, the rules of the world will bring disaster, and he will no longer be able to escape!"

"Sacrificing a great power and a race, the Outer Human Race has made a big investment this time. It depends on whether the Zerg Race will be counterattacked by the rules of the world!"

"If the Zerg can successfully survive this disaster, the Tianwai Human Race will really suffer a huge defeat this time, and their status as a super clan will be affected!"

"Haha, the arrogant Tianwai Human Race is also here today, I feel happy just thinking about it! I hope the Zerg Race can survive this!"

"The Zerg always bring miracles, I hope this time it will be the same!"

"..."

The strong men from the local race camp were watching the battle from a distance, and their hearts were filled with excitement.

In this world, it is rare to see powerful people take action. This time, they have seen enough.

"Hangka...crack...!"

A very close and loud thunder sounded near the great power of the human camp outside the sky.

This strong warning gave the powerful man from the human camp outside the world a feeling of impending disaster. Although he had some expectations for this situation, when he actually faced it, he still flinched a little, and the frequency of his attacks unconsciously slowed down. .

"The rules of the world have chosen me as the carrier of disaster, so I can take action in compliance with the law!"

The insect queen suddenly said to Wu Qing.

"Then kill him!"

Wu Qing did not hesitate. As long as the rules of the world allowed it, of course he would ruthlessly destroy the great power of the human camp outside the world.

Wu Qing and the Worm Queen had already expected this situation, but they both believed that the rules of the world would directly bring disaster and eliminate the great powers of the human camp outside the world who took action. A life with ten-star powerful strength, for a world , still too small.

Even if this is a world with broken world rules, it is still a strong world that can persist in the face of so many disasters.

Unexpectedly, the rules of the world would directly choose to let the insect queen take action to eliminate this harmful creature that is wreaking havoc on the world.

Wu Qing instantly thought that this might be related to the Zerg using the special quota of the clan status. The Zerg, which has completed more than 90% of the task progress, can be regarded as a celebrity in front of the world rules.

The subconscious of this world will of course support creatures that are beneficial to the world.

This is the love of the world. In some worlds, this is the treatment of the protagonist.

With the permission of the world rules, the Queen of Zerg no longer cares about it. A terrifying spiritual force suddenly descended on the battlefield. Compared with it, the power of the powerful people in the Tianwai human camp is like the difference between fireflies and the bright moon.

"Pop!"

With a crisp sound, the arrogant Tianwai human camp with a strange appearance was attacked by an irresistible force, and instantly exploded into a firework, and then disappeared into light.

"The powerful Zerg has taken action! So powerful! This is the real power!"

"He killed the powerful of the alien race camp with one strike, and I can't even tell how he attacked!"

"This is a powerful person who is good at spiritual power, the most terrifying existence!"

"Will such a powerful force lead to unpredictable changes?"

"It seems that the celestial phenomena caused by the powerful of the alien race camp are weakening!"

"It seems that the Zerg has successfully survived this disaster!"

"..."

The power of the Queen of Insects has really reached the point where people are terrified.

"Another powerful person has taken action!"

The movement caused by the Queen of Insects's action even attracted the attention of the strong in the main city of the distant native race camp.

After one strike, the Queen of Insects felt that the rules of the world had not yet restricted it.

"I seem to be able to take action!"

The Queen of Insects said to Wu Qing.

"Then take action, the alien race will not gamble anymore, and we will end this war as soon as possible and obtain the status of a great race as soon as possible!"

Wu Qing directly ordered the Queen of Insects, who could still take action, to take action against the army in the main city of the alien race.

This situation is likely to be a punishment from the world rules for the alien race. The alien race is the mastermind behind all this. There are not many things in this world that can deceive the world rules.

Along with the gradually weakening celestial phenomena, a terrifying storm of spiritual power swept across the entire alien race's main city. Under the precise control of the Queen of Insects, all the lives of the alien race's army were wiped out.

A white light lit up in the alien race's main city, and countless lives disappeared at this moment.

No matter what race, what kind of army, what strength, they can't escape the Queen of Insects's world-destroying attack.

"This is the power of the great power!"

Everyone has seen the true power of the great power. Life is worthless in front of the great power.

Except for the part destroyed by the war, the main city of the alien race is intact. All the alien race's troops disappeared, leaving behind a large number of weapons and equipment.

All the space transmission channels leading to the various races of the alien race camp were also left behind. The Queen of Insects used her spiritual power to explore and found that a strong man on the opposite side had destroyed the transmission node on the opposite side.

After the Queen's attack, the restrictions of the world rules came again, and they could no longer attack at will.

None of this mattered. What mattered was that the Zerg finally defeated the super tribe of the evil god camp, the alien race!

As Wu Qing waited patiently, the rewards of the world rules finally arrived. The first to arrive was an unprecedented luck reward, which was more luck than the luck obtained by the Zerg after completing more than 90% of the task progress.

In Wu Qing's expectation, the world rules finally recognized that the Zerg had completed the difficult task of obtaining the status of a large tribe through a special quota!

Wu Qing handed the battlefield to the Queen and returned to his consciousness.

Wu Qing's body moved his mind, and a series of rule forces appeared out of thin air. They continued to gather and slowly formed a ball of light composed of rule forces.

The ball of light continued to absorb rule forces from the unknown land and slowly became solid.

This process lasted for a long time, and finally a ball of light formed purely by the rule forces of this world was generated.

The beautiful rule energy ball of light floated in front of Wu Qing, emitting a bright light, which made people happy at first sight.

Wu Qing did not feel any danger from the rule energy light ball. He reached out and touched the rule energy light ball. A message came over, letting him know that what was in front of him was the power and authority of a great clan that countless races wanted.

This was a special power and authority of a great clan generated for Wu Qing outside a specific area by the world rule. It was of extraordinary significance.

As long as they chose to use this rule energy light ball that represented the special great clan status, the Zerg could obtain the special great clan status.
